subject: Visit planning follow-up
text:
Hi,
Two days after our last exchange, I’m following up to finalize the visit. Please confirm whether Thursday at 10 a.m. still works for you. If not, I can adjust to Friday morning or next Monday. I’ll bring the paperwork we discussed and plan to leave within an hour. If you need anything ready beforehand, let me know by tomorrow afternoon so I can arrange it. Otherwise, reply with a better time and I’ll lock it in. I also want to double-check the gate code before arriving. If the parking area is being repaved, please tell me which side to use.
Thanks
